# Cypher Scripts Over the Neo4j Import Tool

**Decision.** Import the dataset with `LOAD CSV` + `MERGE` Cypher scripts run from the Query editor,
not with Neo4j Desktop's graphical Import tool.

**Date.** 2026-07-10, lab 6 of [[discrete-mathematics-laboratories]].

## Why

The rejected option is named explicitly, in the setup guide, at the exact step where a reader would
otherwise click it:

> "STEP 3.  Left sidebar -> Query.  This opens the Cypher editor where you type and Run commands.
> (NOT the \"Import\" tool - ignore that one, it makes you draw the model by hand. We use Cypher
> scripts.)"
> — Discrete-Mathematics-Laboratories/lab6_Neo4j/guide.txt, 2026-07-10

"It makes you draw the model by hand" is the objection: the GUI import produces a mapping that lives
in the tool's state, not in the repository. A script is text, so it is reviewable, diffable,
re-runnable and quotable in a report.

## What the script form bought

Concretely, when the object count turned out to be wrong:

> "**Data note.** The dataset holds **39** countries; earlier drafts of the guide said 38 (and 950
> `HAS_VALUE`). The numbers were corrected to **39 objects / 975 edges** throughout — the import
> logic itself was already correct (it `MERGE`s one object per row)."
> — Discrete-Mathematics-Laboratories/lab6_Neo4j/README.md, 2026-07-10

Because the import was a `MERGE` script rather than a GUI mapping, it was re-runnable and provably
correct by reading — the fix was a documentation edit, not a rebuild. See [[idempotent-loading]] and
[[cypher]].

## Alternatives rejected

| Option | Why not |
|---|---|
| **Neo4j Desktop Import tool** | model drawn by hand in the GUI; nothing reviewable lands in the repo |
| **`neo4j-admin import`** | bulk offline loader, faster but destructive and not re-runnable against a live DB |
| **A Python driver script** | adds a dependency and a second language to a lab whose deliverable is the Cypher |

**TODO:** only the first rejection is evidenced; the other two are stated as what the alternatives are,
not as choices recorded in the repo.

## The cost, visible in the same file

`guide.txt` is now stale. Its checklist still reads "object count = 38" after the README says 38→39
was corrected "throughout", and STEP 2 hard-codes a personal absolute path that no longer matches the
layout. Writing the procedure down does not keep it true — [[documentation-drift]]. The same file
closes with *"When all are in this folder, say \"screenshots ready\" -> I build the LaTeX report."*
